blocks.text: The Better Endings Tour was supposed to be the ending. It wasn’t. In 2025, Marit Larsen and Marion Ravn gave M2M the ending the duo never got: the first headlining tour of their career that sold out across Asia and numerous countries around the world. Now comes TWO, a brand new global tour that will start in March 2027 in Singapore, Manila, Hong Kong, Jakarta, and reaching Mexico. MANILA will be on April 2, 2027 at the Araneta Coliseum. Tickets will go on-sale on Saturday, October 24 at 10AM via TicketNet.com.ph and TicketNet outlets nationwide. Presented by Wilbros Live. “The Better Endings Tour exceeded our wildest dreams.
